description: This Java class defines a command for modifying an attribute of a 'thing' within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes methods for creating instances from parameters or JSON, validation of inputs, and serialization logic.

classes.name: ModifyAttribute
classes.description: A command class representing an operation to modify a specific attribute of a 'thing' in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It encapsulates the attribute's JSON pointer, the new value, and associated metadata, providing serialization and validation functionalities.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create a new ModifyAttribute instance using a ThingId, JSON pointer, attribute value, and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a ModifyAttribute command instance from a JSON string or JSON object, deserializing the contents.

methods.name: getAttributePointer
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer to the attribute to be modified.

methods.name: getAttributeValue
methods.description: Returns the new value for the attribute.

methods.name: getThingEntityId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the 'thing' entity associated with this command.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Returns the attribute value wrapped in an Optional, compatible with a specific JSON schema version.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer path to the resource being modified.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Serializes the command data into a JSON object builder, respecting schema version and field filtering predicate.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Returns the category of this command, indicating it's a modify operation.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance of ModifyAttribute with updated Ditto headers.

methods.name: changesAuthorization
methods.description: Indicates whether this command changes authorization scope. Returns false.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes a hash code based on the object's fields for use in collections.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks object equality based on class type and field values.

methods.name: canEqual
methods.description: Helper for equals, verifying instance compatibility.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the object.
